description:
The `Tier: <tier> (<reasons>)` line in every oracle review joins `tier_reasons` (report.py:99). The logic-path reason, "changes comparison, validation or result logic: ", lists every matching logic file (classifier.py:84,94). It is not the soundness files that are listed. On oversize canary #2847 (640 files, closed unmerged) the posted review 5475225810 was 128,906 characters, almost all of it this line. GitHub accepted it, but a body that size buries the decision, the note and the reviewer list, and it risks hitting GitHub's body limits on a larger PR.

Required change: cap the file list in the tier reason (for example, the first few paths and "and N more"), keeping the reason text, with a test on a many-file plan. Cap it where the reason is built (classifier.py:88 for the gate reason and :94 for the logic reason) or where it is joined (report.py:99). The plan JSON may keep the full list. Check that the status description, already cut to 140 characters, is unaffected.

Guardrails. No change to how the tier is chosen. Very-high tier (reviewer package); normal oracle PR flow.
